import hashlib,json,struct
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];b=(R/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x32)[0]
def seg(n):
 o,z,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',b,st+8*(n-1));return b[o<<shift:(o<<shift)+z]
d=seg(10);c=seg(3);dx=list(struct.unpack_from('<8b',d,0xa4));dy=list(struct.unpack_from('<8b',d,0xac));s=list(struct.unpack_from('<91h',d,0x25e));co=list(struct.unpack_from('<91h',d,0x314))
assert dx==[0,8,8,0,0,-8,-8,0] and dy==[-8,0,0,8,8,0,0,-8]
assert c[0xe51e:0xe547].hex()=='a3ea4b0bc07d068106ea4b6801813eea4b68017c06812eea4b6801a1ea4bb92d0099f7f98bc8a3ec4b'
assert c[0xe552:0xe567].hex()=='a1ea4b03c0b92d0099f7f9fec0250e00d1f8a3ee4b'
assert c[0xacdc:0xace4].hex()=='6668000002006a43'
def word(v):return ((v+32768)%65536)-32768
def truncdiv(v,n):return abs(v)//n*(-1 if v<0 else 1)
normalization_cases=0;valid=0
for raw in range(65536):
 a=word(raw);out=a
 if out<0:out=word(out+360)
 if out>=360:out=word(out-360)
 expected=a+360 if a<0 else a-360 if a>=360 else a
 assert out==expected
 if 0<=out<360:valid+=1
 normalization_cases+=1
assert valid==1080
def literal_sin(a):
 address=2*a+0x25e if a<90 else -2*a+0x3c6 if a<180 else 2*a+0xf6 if a<270 else -2*a+0x52e
 value=struct.unpack_from('<h',d,address)[0];return value if a<180 else -value
def literal_cos(a):
 address=2*a+0x314 if a<90 else -2*a+0x47c if a<180 else 2*a+0x1ac if a<270 else -2*a+0x5e4
 value=struct.unpack_from('<h',d,address)[0];return -value if 90<=a<270 else value
headings=[]
for a in range(360):
 q=a//90;r=a%90;index=r if q%2==0 else 90-r
 assert literal_sin(a)==s[index]*(1 if q<2 else -1)
 assert literal_cos(a)==co[index]*(-1 if q in [1,2] else 1)
 octant=a//45;step=(dx[octant],dy[octant]);assert abs(step[0])+abs(step[1])==8
 expected=(0,-8) if a<45 or a>=315 else (8,0) if a<135 else (0,8) if a<225 else (-8,0)
 assert step==expected
 doubled=word(a*2);quot=truncdiv(doubled,45);rounded=(((quot&0xff00)|((quot+1)&255))&14)>>1
 assert rounded==((2*a//45+1)//2)%8
 headings.append(dict(angle=a,index=octant,dx=step[0],dy=step[1],rounded_octant=rounded,sin=literal_sin(a),cos=literal_cos(a)))
push_cases=0
for a in range(360):
 for start in [0,1,63,64,2048,4032,4095]:
  x=y=start
  for _ in range(8):x=(x+dx[a//45])&65535;y=(y+dy[a//45])&65535
  assert (x,y)==((start+8*dx[a//45])&65535,(start+8*dy[a//45])&65535);push_cases+=1
diff=[dict(cos_index=i,cos_value=co[i],sine_reverse_value=s[90-i]) for i in range(91) if co[i]!=s[90-i]]
assert diff==[dict(cos_index=60,cos_value=511,sine_reverse_value=512)]
out=dict(exe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),normalization_cases=normalization_cases,normalized_domain_inputs=valid,heading_cases=360,eight_accepted_step_cases=push_cases,dx=dx,dy=dy,sine_quarter=s,cosine_quarter=co,reverse_table_mismatches=diff,heading_samples=headings,runtime_tests=0,limits=['Heading/trig lookup models restricted to0..359','Eight-step model assumes all steps accepted; blocked steps do not decrement','Boundary coordinates use arithmetic wrap only, not proof of valid map access','Derived ray-error terms after E57A and playback API not modeled'])
(R/'pass15/direction_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k!='heading_samples'},indent=2))
